title: SANCTIONED
tagline: You cannot do what you were not meant to do.
premise: A Pilgrim descends a dungeon that sits outside sacred time. The place enforces a single sanctioned path. Every forbidden act BRANCHES the timeline: it spawns a Variant of the Pilgrim and risks either pulling the Pilgrim into the branch or corrupting the room they stand in. Christian iconography (altars, crosses, a Guardian Angel) marks the sanctioned path; the Warden, an archangel, hunts branches.
pillars: Restraint is power: the safe route is to do only what you were meant to do.
Branching is a resource and a risk, never free.
The dungeon reacts to divergence: enemies, corruption, the Warden.
Faith mechanics (prayer at altars) are how you undo or seal branches.
